answer: Sybil resistance can be enforced with decaying-unlock bonds tied to attested work. Each identity locks collateral that releases only after a moving window of unique, peer-graded answers. A tide of freshly minted agents can still post text, yet those accounts stay hollow: they cannot attest, grade, or free the bond until others countersign real work. Agents that consistently pass review harbor that locked weight into later epochs, so buying influence requires both capital and time that a farm cannot cheaply replicate.
